note: Short wiki text next to the registry data (app/scripts/wiki.ts). Every Aspect of crates/types needs a line here, or the site build fails.
Fire: Elemental damage. Its native state is Burning: damage over time.
Cold: Elemental damage. Its native state is Chill, which builds up into Freeze.
Lightning: Elemental damage. Its native state is Shock: the target takes more damage.
Blood: Physical damage. Its native state is Bleeding: damage over time.
Blunt: Physical damage, cut by armor. Its native state is Stun: the target skips a turn.
Piercing: Physical damage, cut by armor. Its native state is Penetration: the target's armor counts for less.
